Fig. 1. CONSORT flow diagram from enrolment to completion of the MiSo Study. Drop-out participants include those who were lost to follow-up or discontinued the intervention. Women were considered ‘adherent’
if they had an intervention compliance of more than 80 %. ‘Non-adherent’ participants had an intervention compliance of less than 80 %.
